name: copy
description: Two offset sheets with uncluttered overlap.
useCase: Copy selected content to the clipboard.
misuse: Announce the result of copying; a visual shape change is not enough.

16.reason: The rear sheet stops at the front sheet contour to avoid doubled strokes; the overall two-sheet silhouette sets the optical center. Text master: 1.5px construction. The complete silhouette is centered within the shared 12 × 12 drawing area.

24.reason: The rear sheet stops at the front sheet contour to avoid doubled strokes; the overall two-sheet silhouette sets the optical center. Interface master: 1.75px construction. The complete silhouette is centered within the shared 18 × 18 drawing area.
